SAMI KANBAN - USER INSTALLATION
==========================================

1. Double-click Install_SAMI_Project_Portfolio_For_User.bat.
2. No administrator rights are required.
3. The installer creates a direct SAMI Kanban shortcut on your Desktop and in your Start Menu.
4. Open SAMI Kanban from either shortcut. It opens the hosted production board at http://SAH0235190:8788/.
5. The shortcut does not start a local server, copy files from Team ESMI, or run a bootstrap health check.
6. If you use a taskbar pin, remove any old SAMI Project Portfolio pin and pin SAMI Kanban after the first launch.
7. Do not manually edit files in the SAMI app folder.

The installer is per-user only. It does not need administrator access and does not change Team ESMI project data.

Team ESMI is not required to open the hosted board. If the hostname is temporarily unavailable, use http://10.23.77.57:8788/ and contact SAMI support.
